user.title: Swiss Parking
user.description: Live free parking spaces from the parking guidance system of a Swiss city. One entry per city — add the integration again for another city. Currently supported: Zürich, Basel, Winterthur, Bern, Frauenfeld.

error.cannot_connect: The city's parking feed could not be reached.
error.no_garages: The city's parking feed returned no garages.

unreachable.title: Swiss Parking: feed for {city} unreachable
unreachable.description: The parking feed of {city} has not answered, or returned no car parks, for several refreshes in a row. Check your internet connection; if it is fine, the city's feed itself is down. The sensors and map markers stay unavailable until then and recover on their own; this notice disappears with the next successful refresh.
